relationships.subject: Polydatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Increased SIRT1 activation by polydatin resulted in peroxisome proliferator activated receptor-gamma coactivator-1α (PGC-1α) directed mitochondrial biogenesis.

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: SIRT1 activation also facilitated Nrf2-directed antioxidant signaling.

relationships.subject: Polydatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with polydatin significantly attenuated mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia in diabetic rats.

key_findings: Polydatin attenuated hyperalgesia and improved nerve function in STZ diabetic rats.
Polydatin acts via SIRT1 to drive PGC-1α mitochondrial biogenesis and Nrf2 antioxidant signaling.
